name: Robot Framework Web Tool
summary: Local web and CLI utilities for Robot Framework output files.

changes: Adjusted Result Editor file summary styling for consistent dark and light mode theming.
Added Test Case export actions to Statistics after analysis, with TXT export for names and CSV export with tags, steps, line numbers, and template information.
Added Paste mode to Test Runner so Robot Framework code can be pasted and executed directly without creating a file first.
Kept the existing Test Runner upload flow compatible while allowing pasted code to use an optional generated file name.
Removed the duplicate Admin Usage block from Report Merger Settings now that the app has a dedicated Admin Dashboard.
Fixed Web Pet speech bubbles so text remains readable when the pet turns around.
Added Robot Template Builder for generating .robot starter files, saving custom templates, and importing/exporting templates as JSON for sharing.
Added Merge Preview / Diff to inspect file counts, overlapping tests, status transitions, metadata conflicts, and update impact before generating merged reports.
Added Flaky Test Detector for uploaded output.xml files to identify tests whose status changes across runs.
Added a lightweight Admin Dashboard with active clients, running jobs, temporary storage, client details, and recent runner jobs.
Added friendly Web Pet assistant notifications for merge previews, metadata conflicts, flaky detection, merge completion, and app updates.
Added Web Pet settings to turn the mascot on or off and choose a specific pet type, with random remaining the default.
Added flying pets: dragon, fly, mosquito, and dragonfly, with higher hover-style movement.
Slowed pet movement, turning, and animation timing so the mascot feels less abrupt.
Expanded the pet render area and speech bubble bounds so growing pets and text are not clipped.
Added metadata conflict detection for report merges so differing metadata values are chosen explicitly instead of being concatenated.
Default metadata conflict selections use the first input file as the standard.
Expanded the web pet container and removed paint clipping so grown pets render fully.
Improved the web pet with smoother CSS keyframe animation for head, legs, tail, wings, and eyes.
Added multiple code-driven expressions: happy, sad, sleepy, and excited.
Made idle growth smoother with continuous scale and gradual SVG shape updates.
Replaced the first web pet prototype with a smoother Tamaweb-inspired mascot engine.
Randomizes a new pet type for each app session instead of persisting the first animal forever.
Expanded the pet roster with cats, dogs, lions, snakes, kangaroos, rabbits, foxes, pandas, penguins, turtles, dragons, and birds.
Added occasional speech/calls, hover avoidance, mouse curiosity, smoother idle movement, and idle growth.
Added a lightweight animated web pet inspired by cursor-chasing mascot projects like oneko.js.
The pet randomly appears as a cat, dog, lion, snake, or kangaroo and grows from baby to adult while the app stays open.
The pet wanders near the bottom of the app, sometimes approaches the mouse cursor, and moves away when hovered.
Added centralized version metadata, changelog, and About dialog.
Added source auto-reload and browser update notification for local deployments.
Added active client and running job usage metrics for admins.
Defaulted report flattening and latest-result update history for new browser settings.
Added selective Update / Replace in the web UI.
Added CLI options for selected test updates: --test, --tests, and --tests-file.
Added --list-update-candidates to inspect replaceable test cases before merging.
Added dark and light theme support.
Improved report merger settings and cleanup controls.

app_guide.title: Report Merger
app_guide.description: Upload two or more Robot Framework output.xml files, choose Combine or Update / Replace, then download the merged output, report, and log.

app_guide.title: Selective Update
app_guide.description: In Update / Replace mode, keep the default all-test update or load matching test cases and select only the results/logs you want to overwrite.

app_guide.title: Merge Preview
app_guide.description: Preview status transitions, overlapping tests, metadata conflicts, and update impact before creating merged output files.

app_guide.title: Flaky Detector
app_guide.description: Upload multiple output.xml files to find test cases that switch between PASS, FAIL, SKIP, or other statuses across runs.

app_guide.title: Statistics
app_guide.description: Upload or paste a .robot/.resource file to inspect test cases, keywords, variables, settings, source lines, and export the test case list.

app_guide.title: Test Runner
app_guide.description: Run an uploaded Robot file or paste Robot Framework code directly, stream console output, then download or view generated results.

app_guide.title: Template Builder
app_guide.description: Generate reusable .robot starter files, save custom templates locally, and import or export template JSON for teammates.

app_guide.title: Name Formatter
app_guide.description: Preview and apply batch test-case renaming rules such as regex replacement, prefix/suffix, templates, and numbering.

app_guide.title: Web Pet
app_guide.description: A small animated pet roams around the app, grows over time, reacts to the mouse, and announces useful app events when enabled.

app_guide.title: Admin Dashboard
app_guide.description: Monitor active browsers, running jobs, temporary storage usage, and recent runner jobs from the Admin panel.

cli.description: Standalone CLI report merger for Robot Framework output.xml files.
